translations.web: “ ‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s wife. It is your father’s nakedness.
translations.bsb: You must not have sexual relations with your father’s wife; it would dishonor your father.
translations.kjv: The nakedness of thy father's wife shalt thou not uncover: it is thy father's nakedness.
